subject: fix(web): prevent webpack from parsing vendored model-viewer (#3938)
summary: Prevents webpack from parsing the vendored vendor/model-viewer.min.js file in both the desktop app (src/app/webpack.config.js) and web-app (src/web-app/webpack.config.js) build configurations by adding a parser: { import: false } rule, and removes the now-unnecessary ignoreWarnings suppression filter.
verdict_reason: A small, correct build fix that eliminates a webpack critical dependency warning by properly excluding a vendored file from parsing, approved by an admin maintainer with all CI checks passing.
